notes.title: 🌊 New Demo Patch d0.2.8 is here 🏁
notes.notes: [p]A fresh demo update for [i]Tidal Rush[/i] is now live, bringing a lot of visual upgrades to the UI and plenty of fixes. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3]Visuals & UI[/h3][list][*][p]Consistency pass across major UI screens (track/character select, leaderboards, main menu and more[b])[/b] – : cleaner icons, updated stat bars, and improved formatting.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboards improved with scrollable entries, better placement handling, and visual polish.[/p][/*][*][p]Backgrounds updated with new effects, particles, and fade transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Blur effects and tidier presentation across frontend menus.[/p][/*][*][p]New waterfall VFX in Shatterstone Caverns[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay & Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Wrong way indicator added.[/p][/*][*][p]Drift steering deadzone adjusted to reduce unintended drifts.[/p][/*][*][p]Autopilot recovery tweaked; invincibility and stuns better respect shields.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping is now possible on sand and solid surfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded vertical draft zone for smoother racing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Controller layouts and navigation fixes in frontend menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby stability fixes (e.g. preventing overfill, handling bot removal).[/p][/*][*][p]Post-race audio mixing adjusted for clearer results screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous animation fixes for hits, character impacts, and UI transitions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Extras[/h3][list][*][p]Added Wishlist button to the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update is a big step forward in polish and playability. Jump back in and let us know how the improved visuals, UI, and racing feel. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue shaping [i]Tidal Rush[/i]! 🌊🚀 Write a Steam review or drop your feedback directly into our [url="https://discord.gg/EwxMmqDfap"]Discord server[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]New Content Coming Soon[/h3][p]The[b] [/b]team is working on two brand new tracks which we already briefly showed in our [url="https://www.twitch.tv/tidalrushofficial"]Twitch Live Stream[/url]. So follow the game to be informed about the latest updates, because Grand Prix and new tracks are coming soon.[/p]

notes.title: Tidal Rush DevLog Live on Twitch
notes.notes:
[h1]New DevLog Live Stream on Twitch[/h1][p][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]we just wanted to do a short announment about our new DevLog live stream on [url="https://www.twitch.tv/tidalrushofficial"]Twitch[/url], which is going to happen every Tuesday and Thursday at 4pm (CEST) from now on. [url="https://www.twitch.tv/tidalrushofficial"]Hope to see you there[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Rosi & Ronny [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483672/01b48bc031208f6dab39e475de386b4be81f5ab9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch d0.2.2: Leaderboards are here!
notes.notes: [p]A fresh new tech demo build of Tidal Rush is here, and we have something cool stuff for you record hunters: [b]Leaderboards (Records) are live![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483672/1f11be0b2a6d08699f02571a524b1456a069cacc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Your total race times are now tracked automatically, with filtering by engine tier (power level) and lap count. Tracking best lap times is still in the making, but should follow soon as well. See how you stack up and chase faster laps! Race against your friends for the fastest times or challenge our developers.By the way - we are going to flag developers as such soon, so you know who you are chasing ;).[/p][p]Jump back in and let us know how the new leaderboards feel – we’re excited to see your fastest times! 🚀[/p][p][/p][h2]🎮 [b]Gameplay & Controls[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Smoother drift transitions and improved weapon launching on slopes.[/p][/*][*][p]Autopilot now aligns better with water surfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart Race option added in single race/time trial.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🎨 Visuals & UI[/h2][list][*][p]Updated character/vehicle select screen with stat bars, close-ups, and new idle animations.[/p][/*][*][p]New shader effects: rim lighting, fresnel highlights, and cleaner materials.[/p][/*][*][p]UI tweaks for ultrawide support, better scrolling, and tidier layouts.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Other Fixes & Tweaks[/h2][list][*][p]Layout adjustments across tracks and menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved checkpoints, pickups, and AI paths.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes and polish passes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch d0.2.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Gameplay improvements & content updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Say hello to our brand new character JDJ[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483672/67b93b0bb18d6e52bc5967fac38c97c9c5195d0a.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Updated character selection screen including new portraits[/p][/*][*][p]Various ghost fixes including avoiding the player's storage being cluttered with ghost data[/p][/*][*][p]Auto teleport player back on track if out-of-the-world position detected[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced pickup respawn timer down to 1 second[/p][/*][*][p]Various Multiplayer fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Small weapon fix hopefully preventing shield double hitting[/p][/*][*][p]Tweak to how drift steering extents are set up, now set to prevent perfectly straight drifting[/p][/*][*][p]Intended fix for Geyser sloped wall collision[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]CPU Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Various race result screen updates including new character portraits and unique names for CPU opponents[/p][/*][*][p]CPUs now use items smarter and more efficiently, be aware of torpedos![/p][/*][*][p]Some more CPU drifting logic work, so they can execute nice long drifts[/p][/*][*][p]Background work for implementing different bot types in the future[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dynamic branching so CPUs take different routes[/p][/*][*][p]CPU racers can now safely use jump-drift just as regular players[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Environmental updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated skybox adding the sun[/p][/*][*][p]Updated material assignment inside of dropship water[/p][/*][*][p]Various experimental tweaks to water appearance[/p][/*][*][p]Various visual improvements to the mud pools[/p][/*][*][p]Updated hollow tree[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]More improvements and fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Various animation fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Boost VFX is now transparent as to not get picked up in screen space water reflection[/p][/*][*][p]Small fix for weapon explosions[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Tidal Rush Tech Demo live now!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hold on tight, dive into the waves – and leave your rivals behind![/b][/h3][p]We’re absolutely thrilled to celebrate a huge milestone today:[/p][p][/p][p][b]The tech demo of Tidal Rush is now available for you on Steam![/b][/p][p]Tidal Rush is a fun, fast-paced racer inspired by the golden era of the genre – with a fresh, modern twist. Now you can get a first look at what we’ve been passionately developing![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What awaits you in the tech demo:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Online multiplayer (up to 8 players)[/b][/p][p]Race against players from all around the world! [i]Note: Automatic matchmaking isn’t available yet – we’re working on it![/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Two playable characters[/b]
Choose one of our furry pilots and show what you’re made of.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shatterstone Cavern – our first track[/b]
Dash through lush alien forests, crystalline caves, and bubbling geysers![/p][p][/p][p][b]Power-ups & water physics[/b]
Grab boosts, dodge mines, and master roaring waves.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your feedback is highly appreciated![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This is a very early stage of development – which means:[/p][list][*][p]Things might break, crash, or look weird.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]But that’s exactly why we need you![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Help us make the game better:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Share your feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Report bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Discuss with us on our [url="https://discord.gg/EwxMmqDfap"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Leave a review on Steam[/p][/*][/list][p]We read everything and take it seriously. Help us shaping the future of Tidal Rush.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The tech demo is just the beginning! In the coming months, we’re planning:[/p][list][*][p]More characters & tracks[/p][/*][*][p]New racing features: stunts, diving, and more[/p][/*][*][p]A single-player campaign[/p][/*][*][p]New PvP modes & battle systems[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking & progression systems[/p][/*][*][p]And plenty of surprises...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank you to you & our team[/b][/p][p]A huge thank you goes out to our amazing team at Shiny Dynamics, who brought this first version to life with passion – and to you, our community, who make it all possible.[/p][p]We hope you like what you see – and we’re excited to hear your feedback![/p]
